description: An RTL request served by an LTR donor, with both donor-rule consumers in one string. ar carries only a marker, so an ar request for Article is supplied by the en fallback. getResult hands getInternal the candidateLocale (DefaultStrings.java:712) — the same locale shouldApplyBidiIsolation consults at :1367 and the same one the resolver is handed at :1167 — so under the default RTL_LOCALES the interpolated Hebrew name must NOT be isolated AND the resolver must be handed en. The template joins the phonetic branch and the caller-supplied name with a pipe so neither channel can be satisfied while the other is wrong. A per-call bidiIsolation override on this same fixture then shows the two knobs are independent.
